race.description: More From Tote With Ladbrokes (Bm78) Hcp
race.comment: OCEANA DREAM (5) resumes. She made a good impression first up last time in at Caulfield beating the talented mare First Chorus who was a winning machine over the Winter. Form after was rock solid and this looks a very winnable affair first up if ready to go. TWO WOLVES (7) was a smart winner at Pakenham Synthetic last time as favourite, posting some sharp splits late. He draws well and can go on with it. GENEVA (9) resumes for a new yard having last been seen in a G1 SA Derby. Wary of any support, the stable typically go well fresh. NATION'S CALL (3) has been good his past couple and is in the mix up on speed.
